name: claude-mem
description: Captures Claude Code tool usage as searchable observations and replays summarized context into new sessions, giving coding agents memory that survives restarts.

skills.name: Search Memory Index
skills.description: Returns a compact index of past observations from full-text queries, filtered by type, date, or project, at 50-100 tokens each.

skills.name: Fetch Full Observations
skills.description: Retrieves complete observation details for a batch of filtered IDs, deferring token cost until results are confirmed relevant.

skills.name: Browse Observation Timeline
skills.description: Shows chronological context around a specific observation or query so agents see what happened immediately before and after.

skills.name: Inject Session Context
skills.description: Captures tool usage through five lifecycle hooks, generates semantic summaries, and injects prior-session context at startup.

skills.name: Sync Memory To Cloud
skills.description: Backs up observations to cmem.ai as the worker writes them, with no daemon, making memory reachable from any connected MCP client.
